syn: rtmon [ OPTIONS ] file FILE [ all | OBJECTS ] ⏎ OPTIONS := { f[amily] { inet | inet6 | link | help } | -4 | -6 | -0 | -V[ersion] } ⏎ OBJECTS := [ link ] [ address ] [ route ]

o.en: Specify protocol family. 'inet' is IPv4, 'inet6' is IPv6, 'link' means that no networking protocol is involved and 'help' prints usage information.
Use a special family identifier meaning that no networking protocol is involved. Shortcut for -family link.
